description: Unofficial WhatsApp desktop linked-device client built with Tauri and whatsmeow.
notes: Upstream marks this unofficial client as private-testing software, not a production-ready WhatsApp Desktop replacement.
Agent Control is experimental and can grant allowlisted chats full local command execution with network access and no approval prompts. Leave it disabled unless you fully trust the configured chats.
Linked-device credentials and profile data are stored outside the Scoop directory under %LOCALAPPDATA%\rust-meow; uninstalling the app does not remove this data.
